zaro: Zarr via Arrow

Source: R/zaro-package.R
zaro-package.Rd

A low-level reader for Zarr arrays (V2 and V3, including sharded V3), native or virtual, from local disk, HTTP(S), S3 and GCS. Virtual stores read the bytes of existing NetCDF, HDF5 and GeoTIFF archives in place, from Kerchunk JSON and Parquet references, VirtualiZarr manifests and byterefs tables (SQLite, or the flat Parquet export read by row group). Every read is a plan of byte references (one row per chunk) fetched through one curl connection pool, then decoded in R. Zarr arrays can also be opened as lazy R arrays (via altarr) with CF unpacking. Arrow and GDAL (via gdalraster) are optional, for S3 and GCS listing and credentials and for some codecs.
